commit 12ebeb972e2bea88bec939a9ca9b436db884de13
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 23:25:53 2026 +0300

    feat: T660.3 nested worktrees do not leak into walks, gc or clean (#1072)
    
    A linked worktree nested in its project (under .rtok/worktrees) is another checkout: search, tree, the graph walk and the watcher skip it, gc and clean take the deepest worktree as current, origin names the rtok pool, and a new worktree's symbol index copies no rows under .rtok/. Submodules and nested clones stay walked.

commit 8511b43b5da7984151d14def934f067383c6ff51
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 12:27:09 2026 +0300

    test: T666 commands_e2e runs rtok outside the checkout (#1067)
    
    The cmd() helper isolated HOME/RTOK_HOME but left the cwd at the checkout,
    so doctor_reports_the_chain ran rtok doctor there and its junk section walked
    every real worktree of the repository (>180 s on a machine with many large
    worktrees). The helper now runs in the temp home, like agents_junk, web_e2e
    and doctor_checklist_pty already do. A time budget for doctor's junk section
    is filed as I-132.

commit 7067aab339d17d29d569978ae1faf6b6d9647194
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 12:20:01 2026 +0300

    feat: T276.3 T276.6 run every external program through ProgressRunner and ban Command::new (#1057)
    
    * feat: T276.3 run host CLIs and the doctor MCP probe through ProgressRunner
    
    - `run_cli` runs through `ProgressRunner` with the Windows shim and a
      `running <bin> <subcommand>…` spinner; `spawn_cli`, `version_command`
      and `shell_shim` are gone.
    - `app_version` is a quiet runner with the 3 s limit; `src/proc.rs`
      (`capture`) is deleted, its behaviour and tests already live in
      `rtok_sys::proc` (grandchild-held pipe, 128+signal, timeout kill).
    - `rtok mcp ping` asks the host CLI through the runner (`asking <bin>…`).
    - `rtok doctor` spawns each MCP server through the runner and draws a bar
      over the servers (`probing MCP servers… <name>`); `mcp_command` is gone.
    - The installer prompt (rtok-agent-sdk `ask`) runs inside a registered
      pause that hides every live bar, so `agents install/update/remove` keeps
      its host bar on a terminal instead of turning it off for any run that
      may ask (T81).
    
    Tests: the SDK pause wraps the question; the CLI label names only the
    subcommand; `rtok doctor` with an MCP server writes no bar bytes to a
    piped stderr.
    
    * feat: T276.6 retire the point indicators and ban Command::new outside rtok-sys (#1059)
    
    - `with_loader`, `render::loader` and `render::spinner` are gone: in-process waits go
      behind `ProgressRunner::wait`, and `graph index` steps a `Batch` over the files that
      pass the stat gate (`Batch::hidden` for the MCP tool and the watcher).
    - The last production `Command::new` sites (`git describe` for plugin versions, the
      task adapter's token command) run through `ProgressRunner::quiet`.
    - `clippy.toml` bans `std::process::Command::new`; `just lint` denies it in libraries
      and binaries, rtok-sys opts out in its proc module, build.rs keeps its own git calls.
    - Drop indicatif from the root crate: rtok-sys is now the only place that draws.
    
    * fix: T276.3 keep piped stdio when the Windows shim swaps the command
    
    `run_piped` and `spawn` set stdout and stderr before `prepare` replaced the
    command with `cmd.exe /D /C`, and `Command` cannot hand stdio over, so a
    shimmed `.cmd` host wrote its `--version` straight to rtok's stdout
    (agents_update, agents_list_content and agents_plugin_version on Windows).
    Stdio is now set after the shim. The new tests are Windows-only, since the shim is
    a no-op elsewhere; the failing Windows CI run on #1057 is the fail-first evidence.

commit 628825f7add119cda6ed204b11e8b8d16f32819c
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 11:54:33 2026 +0300

    fix: T655 make compressor in-flight admission atomic (#1056)
    
    * fix: T655 make compressor in-flight admission atomic
    
    `submit` checked `in_flight` against the cap, marked the id seen, and only
    then incremented, so concurrent submits could all pass the check and run
    past `max_in_flight`; an id refused at the cap had also already been
    marked seen and was never retried. Admission now reserves the slot first
    in one compare-and-swap, then marks the id seen; a duplicate or a
    poisoned lock drops the slot, handing the reservation back.
    
    Tests: 32 threads racing at cap 1 admit at most one (the old
    check-then-increment order, with a yield to widen the window, admitted
    23); an id refused at the cap is admitted once a slot frees; a duplicate
    returns its reservation.
    
    * style: T655 rustfmt the admission race test

commit edc6c621df9187784cf93c32851a886b1476a0d4
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 11:50:30 2026 +0300

    fix: T656 keep worktrees and caches when their age cannot be established (#1055)
    
    The newest-mtime walk skipped unreadable directories, entries and mtimes
    silently, so a partial walk could report an old mtime (or none) and
    `worktree clean` / `worktree gc` treated the tree as idle and deleted it.
    The walk now records that it was incomplete; `clean` keeps a cache whose
    age is unknown or rests on an incomplete walk, and `gc` keeps a merged
    worktree whose age is unknown. A recent file found anyway still reads as
    active.
    
    Tests: the old `no_mtime` case expected deletion (None) and now expects
    the "age unknown" keep; new tests cover an unreadable directory marking
    the walk incomplete, an incomplete walk never reading as idle, and gc
    keeping a merged worktree of unknown age.

commit 845af7ed403e158b967f161b18cafbde089a6e5e
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 11:48:49 2026 +0300

    fix: T654 re-read graph files after an unreadable index attempt (#1054)
    
    An unreadable file was stored with its real mtime and size, so restoring read access (which changes neither) left the stat gate skipping it with no symbols. It now stores the unknown stat (0, 0); a non-UTF-8 file keeps its stat as before (T36.16).

commit 888b0548ad3990462e2df857fed6ffdd201b5334
Author: Ivan Tugay <listepo@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Oct 14 11:48:22 2026 +0300

    fix: T651 honor ProgressRunner timeouts with inherited output (#1053)
    
    Output::Inherit used Command::status, which cannot be bounded, so .timeout() was
    ignored for inherited children. Spawn and reuse the piped path's wait so the
    direct child is killed and reaped at the deadline.

    fix: T657 match compressor credentials to the internal provider (#1052)
    
    The compressor sends an Anthropic Messages body, so only credentials from an Anthropic-wire
    agent turn may reach it. An OpenAI bearer was forwarded there; Auth::from_headers now takes

    Also applies the rustfmt layout that tests/skill.rs needed for fmt-check.

    * docs: claim T663 just dup under the jscpd threshold
    
    * refactor: T663 shared agent impl macros and apply assertion bring just dup under 2%
    
    jscpd rose to 2.09% (424 clones) with the T413 install hosts, each repeating
    the impl Agent head (id/variants/readme), the single-file MCP-only tail
    (files/installed/apply) and the apply-idempotent test body. agent_identity!,
    mcp_only_file! and assert_mcp_only_apply_idempotent now hold one copy each;
    just dup reports 1.81% (388 clones). Threshold and ignores unchanged.
    
    * docs: claim T664 report --ai keeps #doctor under the default budget

    only T663 fixes, so neither side could go green alone.
    
    * style: T663 oxfmt web/e2e/rtok.ts
    
    The same hunk as T662 (#1049): main's js gate fails on this file and #1049
    fails on dup, so #1058 carries both to break the deadlock.
    
    * fix: T664 report --ai keeps #doctor under the default budget
    
    The doctor section of the AI report printed four module lines per T413
    host variant, each with its not-supported reason, and outgrew the default
    [report] budget_tokens on an empty home, so tests/report_ai.rs failed on
    main. The AI report now renders one line per host variant; rtok doctor and
    the other report formats keep the full lines.

    Same hunk as #1051, so either merge order applies cleanly.
    
    * fix(test): keep the Windows nextest temp dir outside the checkout
    
    Since #1036 TMP/TEMP on Windows pointed at target\test-home\tmp, inside the
    repo, so git discovery from a test's scratch dir found the checkout and 7
    tests that expect a directory without git failed on windows (1/2).
    
    * style: cargo fmt tests/skill.rs
    
    * test: expect the Windows test tmp outside the checkout
    
    #1063 moved TMP/TEMP on Windows from target\test-home\tmp to %TEMP%\rtok-test-<hash>,
    so nextest_runs_under_the_test_tmp failed there. It now checks the rule on every OS:
    an rtok-test-* dir outside the checkout, under /tmp on Unix.
